verdict.rationale: CDP ships client SDKs (cdp-sdk), a CLI, and REST APIs with webhooks, all of which are inherently scriptable/headless and usable in CI pipelines without a GUI, and docs explicitly describe programmatic wallet, payment, and x402 automation flows. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), and independent/hands-on confirmation of headless automation in production.
